lines.zh: 我飘过去，脚下什么都没有
lines.en: I drift, nothing under my feet
My cloak turns in the wind
I fly around a dead tree
My face hides under the hat

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的树间穿行
lines.en: I thread the dark forest trees
I drift not fast, but never off course
My body is light as cloth
A thin black mist trails me
I come from the crimson forest side
I drift over dead grass
I turn and my cloak sweeps
I head for where someone is crying
I stop by a dead tree
My cloak hangs still
It is very dark under my hat
I am deciding who to frighten
My fingers are long and thin
There is little light in the dark forest
Mist coils around my claws.
A crow on the tree watches me
I hover among the trees, listening.
I wait for the sun to go down
Nobody can hear my laugh
It is quiet here, I like it
I am seeing which tree is darker
My cloak moves with the wind
You entered the dark forest alone
Do you want to see my face
Can you still laugh
I am not a good thing

lines.zh: 你已经在我旁边站了一会儿
lines.en: You have stood by me a while
Your shadow has grown shorter

lines.zh: 我在你耳边说的话，你听见了吗
lines.en: Did you hear what I said by your ear
Your blade shows my face.
I count to three, then you run
This dark is just right
Do you fear the dark or me
Let me tell you a joke
You cannot laugh, that is normal
I do not show this face often
The breath I exhale is poison.
Stand a while longer and you will miss home
A corner of my cloak tore
I drift back a distance
That scattered my mist
That blow scatters my mist.
I laugh once, drily
I shrink back behind the tree
My cloak is torn.
I am fading almost out of sight

lines.zh: 绯红森林的毒息，从我嘴里过。
lines.en: Crimson forest poison passes my lips.
You have more nerve than I thought
I do not eat these
What you bring will taste wrong
You keep this
I prefer watching people tremble

lines.zh: 你举着它，我闻得到你的害怕
lines.en: Holding it up, I can smell your fear
Set it down, let us play a game
That much sincerity is not enough
I am not hungry, I am bored

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，我就笑
lines.en: Put it on the ground and I will laugh
I take no gifts, I take laughter
You want me to laugh, right
I have noted this smell
You walked into my cloak
My cloak is thicker than it looks

lines.zh: 你退开时带起了一阵凉风
lines.en: Pulling away stirred a cold breeze
I have no weight at all

lines.zh: 这一下你摸到的都是布
lines.en: All you touched was cloth
I slipped behind you

lines.zh: 你的肩从我身上穿过去
lines.en: Your shoulder passed through me

lines.zh: 我们之间没有真的碰到
lines.en: We never really touched
My mist rubbed off on you
You shivered
Few of us in the dark forest

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁更吓人
lines.en: When kin meet, we compare scares
Two drifting together make thicker mist
We need not come close
Its laugh makes no sound
We each went our way

lines.zh: 黑森林够我们各占一边
lines.en: The forest is big enough for one side each
There is an understanding between us
Frightening together takes less effort
Let us part for tonight
I lift it with spindly fingers
What would I do with this
I will hang it on your door
Dropped things are better left
I turn it over to catch the light.
It loses its warmth in my hand
I drop it at your feet
I flick it up on a claw tip.
I keep it for later
You had better not look for it
Someone has come into the dark forest
I smell your fear
You are on the right path
I am under that tree ahead
I pull my cloak a little lower
No need to look back. I'm in the wind.
Your footsteps are trembling
Moonlight can't find my wings.
I have drifted ahead of you
My shadow slides along the bark.
The game begins
From now on, do not laugh
My mist creeps along the trunks.
My mist hugs the ground
I hold my poison breath.
Every tree here looks the same

lines.zh: 我的翅膀不出一点声音。
lines.en: My wings make no sound.

lines.zh: 你听，那声音是你自己的
lines.en: Listen, that sound is your own
I slip behind another tree
The dark forest has no exit

lines.zh: 夜魔兽的毒息，隔着也够。
lines.en: Boogiemon's poison breath reaches from here.

lines.zh: 我在树枝间换了个位置。
lines.en: I shift between the branches.
I drift behind you
A few more steps and you reach open ground
I reach out from my cloak

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的脖子
lines.en: My fingers touch your neck
That left no wound
I laughed once by your ear
Your whole body went stiff
I drop my cloak over your head

lines.zh: 你在黑里什么都看不见
lines.en: You can see nothing in the dark
That grab was cold
Poison breath pours from my mouth.
My claws tear the air.
I wrap my cloak around you
What you felt was my finger

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的雾里出来
lines.en: I come out of the dark forest mist

lines.zh: 这棵树下面多了个影子
lines.en: A shape appears under this tree
My cloak appears first
Something glints under the hat

lines.zh: 绯红森林的风把我吹来
lines.en: The crimson forest wind blew me here
The crow on the tree flew off
I laugh low once first
The dark here is just right
The one to meet me has not come
I drift slowly into the middle of the path
A hat appears in the mist
I stand at the far end of the path
The firelight shows my face

lines.zh: 我从雾里掉下去，散了一半
lines.en: I fall out of the mist and half scatter
Water presses me down heavily
The blast blew my mist apart

lines.zh: 飞来的东西穿过了我的斗篷
lines.en: Something flying passed through my cloak
That force is nastier than I am

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是越来越没力气
lines.en: I am not hungry, only weaker
Lightning turned the whole wood white
No trees to hide behind in the void.
